visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a colorful festival float at night. Several performers, including children and young adults, are dressed in elaborate traditional Chinese costumes with heavy theatrical makeup and ornate headpieces. They are sitting on the float which is decorated with large paper flowers and lights. (2) The scene shifts to a wide shot of a massive crowd filling a city street at night. The street is lined with multi-story buildings and illuminated by streetlights and neon signs. A brightly lit float is moving through the crowd. (3) A young man with blonde hair and a white shirt is shown from a low angle, waving his arms enthusiastically and shouting toward the float. Around him, many people in the crowd are also waving and holding up their smartphones to record the event. (4) A performer on the float, dressed in a blue traditional robe and a tall black official's hat, speaks into a microphone. The performer has vibrant makeup with pink and floral patterns around the eyes. (5) Fast-paced cuts show various angles of the parade, including fireworks exploding in the dark sky and thick white smoke from firecrackers filling the street. Performers on different floats are seen throwing small items, like candies or trinkets, into the reaching hands of the crowd. (6) A high-angle 'POV' shot from one of the floats looks down at the sea of people below. Fans are holding up signs with names and messages written on them. (7) A group of young girls in the crowd, some wearing face masks, wave at the camera and hold up drinks and snacks they have collected. (8) More shots of the festive night show a dragon-themed float and a phoenix-themed float, both heavily adorned with LED lights and carrying performers in high positions. (9) A girl in a white tank top and denim shorts is seen dancing energetically in the middle of the crowded street, lit by nearby neon signs. (10) The video concludes with a montage of fireworks over the cheering crowd and a group of friends laughing while showing off their bags filled with items caught during the parade.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Bustling city streets at night, filled with crowds, brightly lit festival floats, traditional temple-style architecture, and modern multi-story buildings with commercial signage.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic dance music starts immediately. A male voice with high arousal and excitement begins narrating with clear articulation and a friendly, animated tone. (2) A sharp increase in crowd noise occurs, with audible high-pitched screaming and cheering that overlaps with the music and narration. (3) Loud, percussive rhythmic sounds resembling firecrackers or traditional drums ('dong dong qiang') punctuate the audio track. (4) The narrator continues with a fast speech rate, describing the event as the 'Taiwanese Disneyland.' The music remains continuous with a strong, driving beat. (5) Sounds of fireworks explosions and further crowd cheering are mixed into the background. (6) A digital UI 'ding' sound effect highlights a transition. (7) The BGM shifts slightly in texture during the interaction segments with the crowd, but maintains its energetic tempo throughout the conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the vibrant and exciting atmosphere of the Beigang Yi Ge (Traditional Float) parade during the Mazu festival, highlighting its scale and local significance while encouraging viewers to participate or share the video.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-energy editing, bright colors, and enthusiastic narration to effectively capture a major cultural event. The consistent use of variety-style subtitles and social media icons makes it optimized for short-form video platforms.
